title: 第2029章 陆玄随意出手第2028章 只能召唤陆玄
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “师父！”
这道声音响起，众多诡族强者皆是看向虚空深处。
他们不由得有些好奇。
陆玄真的会来吗？
到时候如果陆玄和苍兀老祖爆发一战，陆玄的实力究竟如何？
众人看向幽林长老和璇玑圣主，只有他们两人知道苍兀老祖的谋划。
幽林长老脸上露出一丝讥笑，“其实，苍兀老祖给陆玄出了一个难题。他必须在空间通道和大昌星域之中选一个！”
闻言，黑龙长老，暗虎长老等人这才恍然大悟。
怪不得之前，幽林长老不让他们出击。
完全就是引诱狠人女帝深入大昌星域啊！
那么现在陆玄一定是，收尾不能兼顾。
去了空间通道，就不能来救狠人女帝和徒弟。
反之亦然！
幽林长老一脸老谋深算道，“如果我是陆玄，就不会来大昌星域。毕竟空间通道更重要！如果山鼎界封印了，那么人族的优势就没了。”
“而他的徒弟死了，后面还能再收徒弟。桀桀桀……叶尘，齐春静，你们说，是不是……”
还没说完。
“咔嚓！”
虚空撕裂！
空间扭曲！
陆玄一袭白袍，身上流转着淡淡的神华，从虚空裂缝之中走了出来，小囡囡则是牵着他的手。
“师父。”
叶尘心中马上安定了下来。
师父来了。
诡族的一切布置，都失去了作用。
而幽林长老等人则是无比震惊。
“你，你，陆玄你是放弃空间通道了吗？”
“呵呵，看来在你眼中，徒弟好像更重要啊！”
“原本以为你也是有大局观的人，没想到想你这样的人，竟然也是重感情的！”
陆玄直接无视了幽林长老。
他拂袖一挥。
鼎足的权柄之力，如同沧海一般向着四周倾泻。
全部向着狠人女帝的场域落下！
如同金色的雨在倾盆的下！
天地无比瑰丽！
很美！
刹时间，原本横亘在狠人女帝等人头顶的恐怖威压之力烟消云散。
弥漫的黑云也褪去了。
不仅如此！
狠人女帝脚下已经崩溃成无数碎片的阵纹，竟然开始重组的起来，如同花瓣一般，光华漫天。
content_en:
"Master!"
This sound sounded, and many powerful people from the Wei clan looked into the depths of the void.
They couldn't help but be curious.
Will Lu Xuan really come?
If a battle breaks out between Lu Xuan and Cangwu Patriarch, what will be Lu Xuan's strength?
Everyone looked at Elder Youlin and Holy Lord Xuanji. They were the only two people who knew the plan of Patriarch Cangwu.
Elder Youlin showed a trace of sneer on his face, "Actually, Patriarch Cangwu gave Lu Xuan a difficult problem. He must choose one between the space channel and the Dachang Star Territory!"
Hearing this, Elder Black Dragon, Elder Dark Tiger and others suddenly realized.
No wonder Elder Youlin didn't let them attack before.
It was completely to lure the ruthless empress deep into the Dachang Star Territory!
So now Lu Xuan must be unable to take care of the ending at the same time.
If you go to the space channel, you can't come to rescue the ruthless empress and her apprentice.
vice versa!
Elder You Lin said with a sly look on his face, "If I were Lu Xuan, I would not come to the Dachang Star Region. After all, the space passage is more important! If the Shanding Realm is sealed, then the human race's advantage will be gone."
"And his apprentice is dead, and he can still accept more apprentices later. Jie Jie Jie... Ye Chen, Qi Chunjing, do you think..."
Not finished yet.
"Boom!"
"Crack!"
The void is torn apart!
Space distortion!
Lu Xuan was dressed in a white robe, with a faint divine glow flowing on his body, and walked out of the crack in the void, with the little girl holding his hand.
"Master."
Ye Chen immediately felt at ease.
The master is here.
All the arrangements made by the Kuei clan have lost their effect.
Elder Youlin and others were extremely shocked.
"You, you, Lu Xuan, have you given up on the space channel?"
"Haha, it seems that in your eyes, apprentice is more important!"
"I originally thought you were a person with a big-picture perspective, but I didn't expect that someone like you is also emotional!"
Lu Xuan directly ignored Elder Youlin.
He waved his sleeves.
"Boom!"
The power of the tripod's power poured out all around like the sea.
They all fall towards the ruthless empress's field!
Like golden rain pouring down!
The world is extremely beautiful!
Very beautiful!
In an instant, the terrifying pressure that originally hung over the heads of the ruthless empress and others disappeared.
The diffuse dark clouds also faded.
Not only that!
The formations at the feet of the ruthless empress, which had collapsed into countless fragments, unexpectedly began to reorganize, like petals, filling the sky with brilliance.
title_en: Chapter 2029 Lu Xuan takes action at will Chapter 2028 Lu Xuan can only be summoned
